question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Grisly
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Grisly"** means something that is causing horror or disgust. (भयानक)

 
 
• **Example: **The police were horrified by the **grisly** crime scene they encountered.
 
 
 
• **"Atrocious" **refers to something that is horrifyingly wicked or of very poor quality. (क्रूर)
 
 
• **Example: **The dictator's** atrocious** acts of violence shocked the world.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Grisly' **is **'Atrocious'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pleasant **(सुखद): Giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather was pleasant, perfect for a day out.
 
 
 
• **Glorious **(शानदार): Having, worthy of, or bringing fame or admiration.
 
 
• **Example: **The team had a glorious victory in the championship.
 
 
 
• **Dire** (भयावह): Extremely serious or urgent.
 
 
• **Example:** The refugees are in dire need of help and support.
